inj_report.short: Burrow (illness) does not have an injury designation ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Burrow dealt with an illness during Week 11 prep, but with no injury tag the 2020 first overall pick has been officially cleared to play Monday night -- and per ESPN.com he is confident he will do so at "full strength." He's thrown at least three touchdowns in each of his last five outings, and over that span he has completed 77.6 percent of his passes for 1,624 yards, 20 touchdowns and three interceptions while turning 13 carries into 47 yards and two scores. The Bengals will face a Commanders defense that ranks 31st in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (244.8) and 30th in red-zone touchdown rate (71.9 percent).

inj_report.short: Allen completed 27 of 45 passes for 304 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Allen threw a four-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore in the second quarter but got picked off twice later in the first half and had a would-be third interception nullified by a penalty on the penultimate play before halftime. Despite some sloppy play and zero rushing production from Allen, the 9-1 Bills cruised past the 1-9 Dolphins as the star QB raised his season total to 25 touchdowns (14 passing, 11 rushing). Buffalo's likely to encounter more resistance Thursday night against the 8-2 Chiefs. Allen is 5-1 against Patrick Mahomes in the regular season but 0-4 when they face off in the playoffs.

inj_report.short: Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Mahomes was clicking early against the Cardinals' defense, capping off the opening possession of the game with an eight-yard touchdown toss to Travis Kelce. The prolific signal-caller would go on to add a 22-yard scoring toss to Kelce shortly before the end of the first half, and he capped off his scoring strikes with an 18-yarder to Xavier Worthy in which the speedy receiver sped up the right sideline. Mahomes now has consecutive 300-yard efforts and has accomplished the feat in three of the past four games, affording him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 12 showdown with Josh Allen and the Bills on Thanksgiving Night.

inj_report.short: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Gibbs unsurprisingly had his work cut out for him against the Buccaneers' typically stingy run defense, but the Lions had the luxury of continuing to pound Gibbs into the line while protecting a second-half lead. Gibbs eventually broke through for a game-long 26-yard run and cashed in with one- and four-yard touchdown runs in the fourth quarter to help ice the victory. While Gibbs fell just short of his fifth 100-yard effort in the last six games, the 2023 first-round pick is up to 13 rushing touchdowns and is averaging 5.0 yards per carry heading into a Thanksgiving Day home showdown against the Bears.

inj_report.short: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.
inj_report.long: Chase posted one of his signature 200-yard performances, with Sunday night's qualifying as the fourth of his storied career and marking his third instance accomplishing it against an AFC North rival. Needless to say, all three components of Chase's receiving line led the Bengals by a wide margin on the night as well, and after failing to hit the century mark in yardage in any of the first six games of the season, the star wideout has recorded at least 141 receiving yards in three straight. Chase is now up to a 64-878-7 line on 87 targets across nine games heading into a Week 11 Monday night home road matchup against the Commanders on Nov. 23.

inj_report.short: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
inj_report.long: It was a up-and-down night for Daniels in the narrow division win, as the third-year quarterback's pair of fourth-quarter interceptions threatened to derail Washington's fortunes. Daniels had the Commanders up by a 17-14 score just past the midway point of the third quarter after tossing one- and 31-yard touchdown passes to Ben Sinnott and Antonio Williams, respectively. However, Daniels subsequently squandered one scoring opportunity by throwing interceptions on back-to-back possessions in the fourth quarter, the first at the Giants' two-yard line. He ultimately made up for it with his game-winning 32-yard scoring strike to Stefon Diggs, marking the quarterback's first three-TD-pass tally of the season. Daniels is up to 1,499 passing yards and a 10:2 TD:INT alongside 280 rushing yards and another pair of scores heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Bengals on Monday night, Nov. 23.

inj_report.short: Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 24 yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Williams continued his highly fantasy-friendly season with his third multi-touchdown showing of the season. The veteran back first struck from one yard out to cap off the opening possession of the game, and he added his second scoring grab of 2026 on an 11-yard catch early in the third quarter. Williams has over 60 rushing yards in three straight games, and he's up to 10 rush TDs, his second consecutive double-digit tally, heading into Thursday's home divisional Thanksgiving clash with the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Lamb brought 11 of 12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Lamb's near-perfect day included his fifth 100-yard effort of the season -- including his second in the last three games -- and his ninth touchdown grab, which came from eight yards out early in the second quarter. Lamb had six double-digit-yardage catches overall on the afternoon, including his game-long 29-yard grab in the first half. Lamb crossed the 1,000-yard mark for the sixth consecutive season in the process, and he'll take an 88-1,108-9 line into a Week 12 Thanksgiving Day clash at home against the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott would strike again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his scoring strikes with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.

inj_report.short: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Williams completed 15 of 23 passes for 181 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints. He added 11 rushing yards on four carries.
inj_report.long: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and both of Williams' TD passes came in the second quarter as he connected with D'Andre Swift on a three-yard shovel pass and Colston Loveland on a 15-yard score. Williams failed to reach 200 passing yards for the first time since Week 2, and he'll take a somewhat disappointing 10:6 TD:INT thorough seven games into a Week 12 clash with the Lions.

inj_report.short: Johnson rushed 23 times for 105 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 38 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Making a second consecutive start in place of Kenneth Walker (groin), Johnson once again provided starter-quality production as both a runner and receiver. The rookie also added his second career TD on a three-yard run late in the first quarter, making it an all-around rewarding fantasy day. The Chiefs expect Walker to be ready to return for a Thanksgiving Night showdown against the Bills in four days, but even if that comes to pass, Johnson has likely earned himself a larger role for the stretch run with his performance the last two contests.

inj_report.short: Cook rushed 22 times for 89 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Cook extended his touchdown streak to nine games with a one-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. He accounted for all but five of Buffalo's rushing attempts as Josh Allen finished without one, but Cook came up short of 100 scrimmage yards for the first time since Week 4. The reigning NFL rushing yards leader continues to put up stellar production heading into Thursday night's home game against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: St. Brown brought in five of six targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: St. Brown set the pace for the Lions in catches while also tying for the team lead in targets, and the sure-handed receiver also recorded his eighth touchdown reception of the season on a 14-yard grab early in the second quarter that opened the scoring for either team. St. Brown's yardage total left plenty to be desired, but he's still up to a 70-792-8 line on 97 targets heading into Thursday's holiday showdown at home against the Bears.

inj_report.short: Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards and caught both his targets for eight yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and Swift wound up leading the backfield in scrimmage yards on the afternoon, highlighting his performance with a three-yard TD pass from Caleb Williams in the second quarter. Swift's 15 touches also led the backfield, as a returning Kyle Monangai got eased back into action with eight touches. Surprisingly, Salvon Ahmed also handled six carries, all in the fourth quarter when the game seemed well in hand. Swift did lose his third fumble of the season, a new career high, but the TD was his 11th of the year, also a new personal best. Monangai could see his workload increase as he puts his turf toe injury further behind him, but Swift seems to have a firm hold of the No. 1 job heading into a Week 12 clash with the team that drafted him in 2020, the Lions.

inj_report.short: Higgins (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: It's a new "injury" for Higgins, but the full participation level suggests it's nothing serious after the wideout was managed late in last Sunday night's blowout win over the Steelers, per Kelsey Conway of The Cincinnati Enquirer. Higgins already has a fantasy-friendly 53 catches (on 73 targets) for 824 yards and six touchdowns through nine games. He's on pace for a career year in 2026.

inj_report.short: Young was listed with a sore foot on Wednesday's injury report but was a full participant in the Panthers' first Week 11 practice.
inj_report.long: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.

inj_report.short: Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Irving worked hard all afternoon against a feisty Lions defense, and outside of his game-long 23-yard run, he scuffled to 45 yards on 17 carries. Irving worked around a hard shot to the abdomen that he sustained in the second half, and he did manage to contribute a rushing touchdown for the fourth straight game when he went in from one yard out in the latter portion of the third quarter. Irving has now equaled a career high with eight rushing touchdowns and is 107 yards short of his second career 1,000-yard season on the ground heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Panthers on Monday night, Nov. 30.

inj_report.long: In Kirk Cousins' return to the Vikings, Jefferson led the team in catches, targets and receiving yards, although Myles Price and Gavin Bartholomew were on the other end of the QB's two touchdown passes. The nine grabs and 13 targets were season highs for Jefferson, while the yardage total was his best showing since Week 5. Despite a disappointing 40-467-4 line on 64 targets through eight games, the star wideout's outlook for the rest of the year is pointed up heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

inj_report.short: Pollard rushed 21 times for 110 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Pollard eclipsed the century mark on the ground for the third time in the last four games, lighting up his old team for multiple productive gains on the afternoon. The veteran back has been bright spot in a dismal 1-9 start for Tennessee, despite game script often working against the ground attack in the second halves of the Titans' games. Pollard remains firmly on pace for a fifth straight 1,000-yard season heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
inj_report.long: The rookie has seized control of the lead-back role for the Broncos, with his 21 touches dwarfing J.K. Dobbins' five, and Coleman's nine-yard TD run early in the fourth quarter put his team in the lead for good. Coleman has piled up 261 scrimmage yards and two rushing touchdowns over the last three games, and there's no reason to think his role will shrink on the other side of a Week 10 bye.

inj_report.short: Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Goff put together an efficient effort on an afternoon where he recorded completions to eight different targets. The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff has a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

inj_report.short: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for three yards and another score in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Ward's final line belies his struggles somewhat, as a Cowboys defense that made a defensive playcaller switch brought him down for five sacks and forced a lost fumble on one of them at Dallas' 20-yard line. Ward did manage to connect with Carnell Tate (59 yards) and Calvin Ridley (12 yards) for his pair of TD passes, the first coming when the rookie wideout alertly got up after not being touched and the second on a broken play where Ward threw across the field after buying several extra seconds with his legs. Ward also had a one-yard touchdown run in the third quarter, and despite Tennessee's team-level misery, Ward has thrown for at least 231 yards and two touchdowns in three consecutive games heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Smith (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Smith dealt with an ankle injury during the week after he was forced from last Sunday's loss against the Bills, but all scans came back clean, and the veteran quarterback is good to go for a road date in Los Angeles. Smith has been able to get the ball to his playmakers this season, but he doesn't have any fantasy upside as a statuesque pocket passer in an offense that likes to run the ball.

inj_report.short: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11 touchdown passes while posting at least 235 passing yards in each outing, but he has failed to reach that yardage total in any of his last four starts while recording only four TDs during the latter stretch. Snapping out of this recent funk won't be easy for Rodgers against the stout Broncos defense Friday.

inj_report.short: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. Over Hubbard's last six games, he surged to 697 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns, and he'll look keep rolling in a Week 11 clash with the Ravens.

inj_report.short: Cousins completed 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
inj_report.long: Brought back to Minnesota at the trade deadline to stabilize the offense, Cousins did exactly that, connecting with Myles Price for a 38-yard TD in the first quarter and Gavin Bartholomew on a 20-yard score in the fourth while guiding Justin Jefferson to season highs in catches and targets. The Vikings' passing game didn't need to over-extend itself, however, as the defense sacked Jordan Love eight times in another dominant performance. Cousins may need to find another gear in Week 11 against the 49ers, but he'll have another week of practice to re-familiarize himself with Kevin O'Connell's scheme first.

inj_report.short: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Facing a Colts defense down both Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee), Collins looked primed for a big night early when he recorded a 42-yard touchdown grab to cap off Houston's second possession. However, C.J. Stroud proceeded to spread the ball around to nine different targets overall, leading to Collins tying his second-lowest reception tally and posting his third-lowest yardage total of the season. However, the star wideout did extend his touchdown streak to three games, and he'll next take aim at what has been an inconsistent Ravens secondary in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.
inj_report.long: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. Shough has gone four straight games without producing multiple TDs, posting a 4:3 TD:INT over that stretch while completing 67.3 percent of his passes with a weak 6.3 YPA. The second-year QB will likely need to be a lot more productive in Week 12 if the Saints are going to keep up with Joe Burrow and the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Warren finished with 29 yards on 11 touches compared to 34 yards on nine touches for Rico Dowdle, as Pittsburgh's backfield duo was held quiet for a second consecutive game. After recording at least 73 scrimmage yards in eight consecutive games to start the season, Warren has produced just 75 yards without a touchdown over the past two games. Warren and Dowdle should continue to split backfield touches Friday against the Broncos.

inj_report.short: Wilson (concussion) caught seven of 14 targets for 106 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: Wilson set a new season high in targets and came one yard short of his Week 3 season high Sunday in his return from a one-game absence due to a concussion. His production came on a mix of passes from Geno Smith (ankle) and rookie Cade Klubnik, the latter of whom saw his first NFL action after Smith exited in the second half. Wilson figures to work as the top target for whomever starts under center in a Week 11 road game against the Chargers.

Rice has at least five catches in four consecutive contests heading into Thursday's Week 12 Thanksgiving showdown against the Bills in Buffalo.

inj_report.short: Henry cleared concussion protocol and was made available to the media following Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers, Giana Han of the Baltimore Banner reports.
inj_report.long: Henry was checked for a concussion in the fourth quarter of the contest, but evidently passed all tests. Prior to his exit, Henry carried 13 times for 94 yards and a touchdown and hauled in four of his five targets for 17 yards. He also lost his second fumble of the season. Henry looks like he'll be ready to handle his normal role as the lead option out of the Baltimore backfield next Sunday against the Texans.

inj_report.short: Flowers caught eight of 11 targets for 97 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
inj_report.long: No other Raven caught more than four passes or saw more than six targets as Flowers continues to build chemistry with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett. The fourth-year wideout has posted a 14-171-0 line on 18 targets in Brissett's first two starts for Baltimore, immediately establishing a strong floor. Flowers will try to keep rolling in Week 12 against what has been a surprisingly vulnerable Texans defense.

inj_report.short: Mayfield (foot/thumb) is listed as active Sunday at Detroit, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
inj_report.long: With the Buccaneers on bye in Week 10, Mayfield was front and center following a report from Mike Garafolo of NFL Network last Sunday that the quarterback's status for Week 11 was up in the air due to a foot injury. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network then reported Tuesday that Mayfield "seems to be trending" toward missing Sunday's game. Mayfield then followed up Wednesday's DNP with limited practices Thursday and Friday, entering the weekend listed as questionable. On Saturday, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reported that Mayfield is tending to a plantar fascia injury, which will require him to wear a special orthotic and new cleats to stabilize the area in order to play. With his availability now confirmed, Mayfield will take on his usual signal-caller duties this weekend, though backup Jalon Daniels is on standby in the event the former needs to come off the field at any point.

inj_report.short: Burden caught two of three targets for 10 yards and added three yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 win over New Orleans.
inj_report.long: It was the worst performance of the season for Burden, who suffered a concussion in the Bears' last game in Week 9 but used a bye week to clear the protocol and avoid missing any additional time. The second-year wideout saw his three-game scoring streak come to an end, and on the season he sports a 51-654-4 line on 69 targets through 10 contests. Burden will look to bounce back in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

inj_report.long: One week after taking a back seat to rookie Jordyn Tyson, Olave re-emerged as Tyler Shough's favorite downfield option, as he set a new season high in targets and topped 100 receiving yards for the fourth time in 2026. Tyson, meanwhile, caught only one pass on two targets, suggesting the Saints' aerial attack may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game. Olave will look to make an impact again in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Brown rushed 10 times for 44 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 39 yards for two touchdowns in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Brown averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry, but as is customary, his rushing opportunities were capped in a Bengals offense that typically takes a pass-heavy approach irrespective of game script. He still benefited from that philosophy, however, as he tied his second-highest reception total on the season while ending his seven-game touchdown drought by hitting paydirt twice. Brown will get another favorable opportunity to build on his production in Week 11, when the Bengals travel to D.C. for a matchup with the Commanders.

inj_report.short: McMillan caught three of seven targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over New Orleans.
inj_report.long: The seven targets led the Panthers on the afternoon, but the second-year wideout wasn't able to do much with them. The 35 yards were McMillan's lowest total since Week 3, and he'll take a 49-660-3 line on 78 targets through nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Ravens.

inj_report.short: Pickens secured seven of 10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Pickens played second fiddle to CeeDee Lamb (11-132-1) in Sunday's blowout win, but that still equated to a rewarding effort for the franchise-tagged receiver. The game marked Pickens' third 100-yard effort of the season and second straight, and he now has seen double-digit targets in four of the last six games overall. Pickens rounded out his day Sunday with his sixth touchdown reception of the campaign on a 10-yard catch in the latter portion of the second quarter, and he should be teed up for another busy day when the Cowboys host the Eagles for a Week 12 matchup on Thanksgiving Day.

inj_report.short: Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Taylor put some distance between himself and promising rookie backfield mate Seth McGowan in terms of workload, as the former outpaced his teammate in carries by an 11-3 margin, even with the latter exiting before halftime with a hamstring injury. However, the extra opportunity was a moot point, as Taylor couldn't find any space to operate as either a runner or receiver. Daniel Jones' mediocre play under center certainly isn't helping the ground attack's cause, and Taylor now has recorded less than 50 rushing yards in three of the last four contests. The star running back will have some additional time to prepare for a relatively favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29. However, if Marks is able to clear concussion protocol ahead of that contest, Montgomery will see his touch count take a hit.

inj_report.short: Head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters Friday that Hall could see a bump in touches for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Howie Kussoy of the New York Post reports.
inj_report.long: "Obviously, [Hall] and Garrett Wilson are guys that we really try to target for the most part...Hall will end up getting a tick more [touches] because, again, he's our starting running back," Glenn said Friday. In his two outings since returning from a five-game absence due to a quad injury, Hall has turned 26 carries into 102 yards (3.9 YPC) while catching seven of eight passes for 93 yards, and he topped 100 scrimmage yards against the Bills in Week 10. Braelon Allen has reverted to RB2 duties in Hall's return, but the former has still been efficient with his touches and is still firmly in the mix for touches despite the return of Hall. The duo will face a Chargers defense Sunday that ranks 15th in the NFL in rushing yards allowed per game (110.2) and limited Derrick Henry to 10 yards on 10 carries (albeit with two touchdowns) in a 23-20 win over the Ravens in Week 10.

inj_report.short: Evans (Achilles) is listed as active Sunday against the Vikings in Mexico City, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: Evans thus is poised for his first game action since Week 6 versus the Commanders after missing the 49ers' last three contests due to right Achilles tendinitis. As for Evans' potential workload, Jay Glazer reported on Fox NFL Sunday that the wide receiver likely will avoid a strict "pitch count," but San Francisco also plans to "be smart" with his snaps. Even a limited Evans is viable for fantasy purposes, but he'll have to contend with RB Christian McCaffrey, WR George Kittle and active WRs Deebo Samuel, Keenan Allen, Jordan Watkins and Jacob Cowing for the attentionA of QB Brock Purdy.

inj_report.long: Diggs paced the Commanders across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his 32-yard catch-and-run touchdown grab over the middle with under a minute remaining sealed the win for Washington. Diggs tied a season high with his catch total while setting a new 2026 high-water mark in receiving yards and targets as well, and the veteran wideout should retain a prominent role throughout the second half of the season with Terry McLaurin (IR, knee) out the rest of the way in 2026. Diggs next takes aim at the Bengals' inconsistent secondary in a Week 11 home matchup on Monday night, Nov. 22.

inj_report.long: Tate had a fairly non-descript day overall despite the Titans' 30-point output, but he rewarded fantasy managers with a 59-yard catch-and run touchdown on which he alertly got up and ran down the left sideline after Cowboys defenders failed to touch him while he was down. The rookie fourth overall pick was making his return from a two-game absence due to a shoulder injury, and the score served as Tate's second, both which have come in his last three games. Tate has at least 58 receiving yards in five of the last six contests, including in three straight, heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.short: McBride caught nine of 14 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. He added four yards on his only carry.
inj_report.long: Working with his fourth quarterback of the season in Josh Johnson, McBride dominated the 40-year-old's attention as no other Cardinal got more than seven targets or hauled in more than four passes. The star tight end wasn't able to do much with the volume, however, as his longest gain went for a mere nine yards. Carson Beck (back) could be back under center in Week 12 against the Commanders, but that might not improve McBride's outlook, as he saw only five targets in Week 10 during the rookie QB's first NFL start.

inj_report.short: Moore caught eight of 10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Moore's four-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter gave him his first multi-game regular-season touchdown streak since Weeks 15 and 16 of the 2025 campaign with the Bears. He briefly left the game later in the first half to have his knee looked at but promptly returned and ultimately reached the 90-yard threshold for a second consecutive game while leading the team in targets. Barring a setback with his knee on a short week, Moore should continue to work as Buffalo's top wide receiver Thanksgiving night against the Chiefs.

inj_report.long: Barkley didn't log a touch after the 8:02 mark of the fourth quarter after he had an apparent left arm injury examined by team trainers, according to Olivia Reiner of The Philadelphia Inquirer. While Barkley wouldn't elaborate on the issue to McGonigal, the running back seemed optimistic about his chances to suit up in Week 12. Barkley finished Sunday's matchup with 17 carries for 75 yards and one touchdown and wasn't targeted by QB Joe Milton. Monday's injury report may provide further clarity on Barkley's situation.

inj_report.short: LaPorta caught one of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munch.
inj_report.long: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early, and LaPorta simply didn't get many chances to make an impact. It was the worst performance of the season for the fourth-year tight end, but LaPorta's gone four straight games without reaching 40 receiving yards or getting into the end zone. He'll try to break out in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

inj_report.short: Williams brought in all four targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The highlight of Williams' afternoon was a 57-yard touchdown reception early in the third quarter where he got free on a post pattern, and the fifth-year veteran also led the Lions in receiving yards. Williams has at least four receptions in four of the last five games, and Sunday marked his third game with more than 90 receiving yards. The 2022 first-round pick is now averaging 17.0 yards per reception heading into Thursday's Week 12 home matchup against the Bears.

inj_report.short: McConkey (back) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Jets.
inj_report.long: Though he wasn't among the Chargers' Week 9 inactives, back spasms led to McConkey not recording any snaps during the team's 44-22 loss to the Texans on Nov. 8.  After not traveling to Baltimore with his teammates for this past Monday's 23-20 win, the wideout was able to practice in a limited fashion Wednesday through Friday before carrying a 'questionable' designation into the weekend. With no known setbacks since, the 2024 second-rounder will give it a go and is on track to reclaim his key role in Los Angeles' WR corps alongside Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris. In the six games he's taken the field in, McConkey has averaged 2.8 catches (on 4.2 targets) for 47.7 yards with one TD, a pace that the 6-foot, 185-pounder figures to pick up if he can avoid injuries in the coming weeks.

inj_report.short: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
inj_report.long: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the rushing output in particular perhaps making him worth a look in superflex leagues or leagues that start two quarterbacks. He lost a fumble and took seven sacks in the loss to the Giants, so Milton may need to show that he can avoid negative plays in Week 11 in order to guarantee himself additional starts.

inj_report.short: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: After a quiet first half, Gordon got free for a 24-yard run on the first possession of the second half to set up Miami's third and final field goal of the afternoon. Gordon was Miami's most effective offensive player as usual, as Kyle McCord threw for just 102 yards in the latter's second NFL start. This was Gordon's seventh consecutive game with at least 64 scrimmage yards, but he'll take a four-game touchdown drought into a Week 12 home game against the Jets.

inj_report.short: Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: The four grabs led the Bears on the afternoon, as the offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye. Odunze's longest gain went for just 19 yards, and rookie Zavion Thomas wound up leading the team in receiving yards thanks to a 40-yard connection with Caleb Williams in the third quarter. Odunze has caught exactly four passes in four straight games, a stretch in which he's produced a 16-261-1 line on 22 targets. The third-year wideout will try to get more involved in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Waddle (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders after practicing fully this week.
inj_report.long: Waddle was limited to just 14 snaps and one catch for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers with a concussion. Following a well-time Week 10 bye, Waddle has progressed through the NFL's concussion protocol, ensuring that Denver's top pass catcher -- who has recorded a 30/337/2 receiving line on 52 targets through nine contests -- will be available this weekend.

inj_report.short: With Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) inactive for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Mayer is in line to see an expanded role in Week 11.
inj_report.long: Mayer has already carved out his share of looks in the team's passing game, but the absence of Bowers -- who leads the Raiders with 70 targets and 50 catches in eight games played -- creates a big void at tight end on Sunday. In that context, Mayer figures to see added volume versus Denver and represents a viable pivot option for those who roster Bowers, or are otherwise in need of help at the position with six teams on bye.

inj_report.short: Loveland caught all three of his targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: While he didn't get much target volume, Loveland was still able to make an impact with a 15-yard TD reception in the second quarter that saw him hurdle a defender without even breaking stride on his way to the end zone. It was the tight end's third score of the season, all of which have come during Chicago's current five-game win streak, and after a slow start to the season Loveland has delivered a 27-282-3 line on 37 targets during that period. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Lions.

inj_report.long: The talented tight end's production continued to suffer collateral damage from Daniel Jones' poor play, but Warren did provide a useful gain on his one catch. The 2025 first-round pick now has recorded Thursday's yardage total or less in three of the last four games, but Warren's outlook may change if Jones, who James Boyd of The Athletic reports head coach Shane Steichen wouldn't rule out demoting when asked after the game, is replaced by Anthony Richardson or Riley Leonard under center.

The Saints' aerial attack simply may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game, which would mark Tyson as a volatile, but high-ceiling, fantasy asset for the rest of the season. The rookie will try to bounce back in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel told reporters Friday that his "expectation" is that Hampton is the lead back for the Chargers, Omar Navarro of the team's official site reports.
inj_report.long: "Generally, my expecation is [Hampton] is our leading ball carrier every week.  ... I knew based on his last two practice weeks, we were feeling like he was going to have a breakout performance at any given time," McDaniel said Friday. That breakout game took place Monday against the Ravens, when Hampton turned 22 carries into a season-high 105 yards and a touchdown in a 23-20 win for the Chargers. With the Chargers getting extra time to rest, Hampton's stock is trending up heading into Week 12 against the Jets, whose defense ranks 30th in the NFL in rushing yards allowed per game (135.3) and 29th in rushing touchdowns allowed (13).

inj_report.short: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.
inj_report.long: Okonkwo exited in the second quarter due to a back injury, but he was back out there on the field after halftime and was the target on both of Jayden Daniels' two interceptions with less than six minutes remaining in the contest. Overall, Okonkwo's eight targets marked a season high, but he also mustered his fewest receiving yards since Week 4. He'll look to build upon his season-long line of 27-263-0 on 39 targets in the Commanders' next game Monday, Nov. 23 versus the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Shakir caught five of nine targets for 101 yards while rushing twice for two yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Shakir led the Bills in receiving yards in the absence of TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), posting 10 more than DJ Moore, who had one more target than Shakir. Sunday marked Shakir's first time reaching the 100-yard threshold since a 110-yard showing in Week 12 of last season. Shakir will look to build on this outing as he searches for his second TD of the season Thursday against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Downs brought in four of five targets for 59 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Playing in his second game as a member of the Chiefs, Downs posted four receptions for the second consecutive contest and upped his receiving yardage total by six over that of his team debut. Downs' quick chemistry with Patrick Mahomes is certainly noteworthy and makes an already impressive air attack all the more effective heading into Thursday night's Thanksgiving road showdown against the Bills.

inj_report.short: Flournoy tallied six catches for 71 yards and one touchdown on seven targets during Sunday's loss to San Francisco. He also recovered a fumble.
inj_report.long: Dallas played catch-up for much of the second half in the offensive slugfest, so quarterback Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times. Flournoy got seven of those targets, finishing third on the team behind George Pickens (18) and CeeDee Lamb (13). Flournoy's six receptions and 71 yards were both his second-highest figures so far this season, and the TD was his third in the past five weeks. That last stat in particular gives him relevance in most fantasy leagues, especially in matchups during which Prescott is expected to air it out often. The Cowboys will seek a much-needed win next Sunday at home against Tennessee.

inj_report.short: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.
inj_report.long: The former Jaguar was the clear No. 1 option in the backfield for the Saints, Alvin Kamara saw just two touches and CJ Donaldson handled five, although Kamara did vulture another red-zone TD on a one-yard reception in the second quarter, Most of Etienne's production came on a 46-yard scamper that saw him tackled just short of the goal line, setting up Kamara's score, but the fact that he was able to produce his first big play as a Saint was still encouraging. Etienne will attempt to build on this performance in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.long: For a second consecutive game, Allen was outplayed by Breece Hall, who produced 108 scrimmage yards on 15 touches. Allen remains the more efficient runner, averaging 5.0 yards per carry to Hall's 3.4 this season, but Hall is the team's preferred option in passing situations, which have been plentiful with the 2-8 Jets frequently in catch-up mode. Perhaps a Week 11 matchup with a Chargers team that's still searching for its first win through Sunday of Week 10 will offer an opportunity to stick with the run and play to Allen's strengths.

Coleman will continue to be an unpredictable fantasy option in Week 11 versus the Dolphins.

inj_report.short: Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Gesicki caught six touchdowns in the first seven games of the season, but he's now produced just three grabs for 20 scoreless yards over the past two contests. The fluky touchdown rate was never going to hold up, and Joe Burrow funnels so many of his targets through Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins and Chase Brown that there isn't a whole lot more to go around to Cincinnati's ancillary weapons. Gesicki is a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option most weeks despite running a bunch of routes as the de facto slot receiver.

inj_report.short: Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.
inj_report.long: The 40-year-old QB was pressed into duty with rookie Carson Beck (back) on the shelf, and Johnson unsurprisingly wasn't really up to the task after the Cardinals fell into a 14-0 hole before the first quarter was over. Johnson spent most of his afternoon finding Trey McBride for short gains, and he did hit Simi Fehoko for a two-yard score in the second quarter. Beck doesn't figure to miss much time, but if Johnson gets another start in Week 12, he'll be taking on a much less formidable Commanders' defense.

inj_report.short: Hockenson (wrist) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.
inj_report.long: After sitting out last Sunday against Green Bay and then logging limited practices Wednesday and Thursday, Hockenson is ready to return against San Francisco in a potential playoff preview. His lack of a designation puts Minnesota's top tight end in position to reclaim his usual role in the passing game that now has Kirk Cousins at quarterback. Hockenson is a TE1 for fantasy purposes.

inj_report.short: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Godwin has now gone back-to-back weeks without reeling in at least three passes after having done so in each of Tampa Bay's first seven contests this year. The wide receiver has yet to exceed 50 receiving yards or reach the end zone over nine games so far during the 2026 campaign, and he will remain an unappealing fantasy option when the Buccaneers return to action in Week 11 against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Waller (knee) is listed as active Sunday against the Ravens, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
inj_report.long: The Panthers kicked off Week 11 prep with their top two tight ends (Waller and Tommy Tremble) not practicing due to knee injuries, after which head coach Dave Canales told Steve Reed of the Associated Press that those issues were a "concern." Both Waller and Tremble were limited Thursday and Friday and entered the weekend listed as questionable. Now that Waller is confirmed to be active -- along with Tremble -- the former will look to continue to build upon his 25-323-4 line on 39 targets that he's accrued in nine appearances this season.

inj_report.short: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Williams was a distant second to Stefon Diggs in receiving yards for the Commanders on the night, but like the latter, the former was on the receiving end of one of Jayden Daniels' three touchdown passes. Williams scored from 31 yards out just past the midway point of the third quarter, his first touchdown since way back in Week 1 against the Eagles. Williams hasn't been able to fully take advantage of the absence of Terry McLaurin (knee, IR) as of yet, but Thursday's score is certainly an encouraging sign heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Bengals on Monday night, Nov. 23.

The highlight of Sutton's solid performance was a three-yard TD from Bo Nix in the first quarter, as none of his receptions went for longer than 12 yards. Denver gets a well-timed bye in Week 10, but if Jaylen Waddle (concussion) isn't cleared to play on the other side of it, Sutton could see bigger volume in Week 11 against the Raiders. On the season, the long-time Bronco sports a 25-266-2 line on 46 targets through nine games.

Johnston's often been able to offset the modest catch totals with big plays, but that clearly wasn't the case Monday night. Johnston will remain a hit-or-miss fantasy option in a Week 11 home matchup against the Jets on Sunday, irrespective of McConkey's availability.

inj_report.short: Spann-Ford caught one of three targets for 26 yards during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Spann-Ford operated as the Cowboys' No. 1 tight end in Week 10 due to the absence of Jake Ferguson (knee). However, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy were the top targets for Dak Prescott. Ferguson is expected to be sidelined for multiple weeks while recovering from his injury, so Spann-Ford should once again top the depth chart in Week 11 against a Titans team that has given up 40-plus points in each of its last two games.

inj_report.short: Perine turned six carries into 14 yards and a touchdown and hauled in all four of his targets for 25 yards during the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: It looked like Chase Brown found the end zone in the fourth quarter for his third score of the game, but replay assist revealed that his knee came down just short of the goal line. Perine came in on the next play and took the ball for a one-yard touchdown to extend the Bengals' lead to 38-10 following Evan MacPherson's successful extra-point try. It was Perine's third touchdown of the season and first since Week 7 against the Ravens, and over his last five games, he has turned 39 carries into 151 yards (3.9 YPC) and two touchdowns while adding seven catches on as many targets for 44 yards and a score. He'll continue to operate as the Bengals' RB2 behind Brown heading into Week 11 against the Commanders on Monday, Nov. 23.

inj_report.long: With Woody Marks (concussion) inactive, Demercado played the complementary role behind lead back David Montgomery, who rushed 26 times for 107 yards in his return from a multi-week groin injury. Demercado was picked up off waivers from Dallas last month.

The wide receiver led his position in offensive snaps (58), besting DK Metcalf (50) in that regard. Bernard entered Week 10 having recorded multiple receptions in five straight contests, and he'll have a good shot to get back on track in Week 11 versus the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Hill turned three carries into four yards and added five catches on seven targets for 34 yards during the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.
inj_report.long: Hill also had a 14-yard carry midway through the first quarter, but the play was nullified by an offensive holding call. The veteran running back connected on a 17-yard catch with Jacoby Brissett late in the third, which set up a 36-yard field goal by Riley Patterson four plays later. Hill's five catches were a season high, and even with the Ravens' quarterback carousel over the last three weeks, the 2019 fourth-rounder has hauled in at least three passes in each of his last five outings. Losers of five straight games, the Ravens will look to turn their fortunes around in a Week 11 road tilt against the Panthers on Sunday.

inj_report.long: Smith has missed five of the Eagles' last six games (and each of the last three contests) due to a hamstring injury, but the veteran wide receiver does not carry an injury designation heading into the weekend. Lemon has been the team's WR1 in Smith's absence, but the former still will be heavily involved in the offensive game plan given that Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for a fourth consecutive game. Joe Milton is getting the start at quarterback for a second straight contest, and the Eagles are facing a Steelers defense that ranks 30th in the NFL in receiving yards allowed per game (260.6). Over his last five outings, Lemon has put together a 27-247-1 line on 39 targets.

inj_report.long: With Travis Etienne back from his weeks-long hamstring injury that saw him miss five games while on injured reserve, the Saints deployed a three-man backfield committee against Carolina. Kamara scored a couple touchdowns, but it was a fluky performance on just five touches and 16 offensive snaps. Audric Estime logged 27 snaps and handled eight touches, while Etienne played 21 snaps and touched the ball 11 times. This is a backfield to avoid in fantasy while it the trio cancels each other out and caps each others' upside.

inj_report.short: Otton caught four of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: The tight end saw a team-high eight targets, drawing a 26.7 percent target share from Baker Mayfield. It still didn't translate into much in the box score, as Otton remains without a touchdown through nine games. He's turned 38 targets into 23 catches for 211 yards this season and is a low-floor fantasy option most weeks.

inj_report.short: Raymond caught four passes for 32 yards on seven targets in Sunday night's 27-24 win over the Bucs.
inj_report.long: Raymond tied Rome Odunze for second on the team in targets behind Luther Burden (nine), but Burden was injured late in the fourth quarter. If he needs to miss any time, Raymond projects to see elevated snaps alongside Odunze and Colston Loveland. The good news for Burden is he'll have two weeks to heal up with the Bears headed into their bye in Week 10.

inj_report.short: Vidal turned two carries into zero yards, brought in both of his targets for 14 yards and returned one kickoff for 32 yards during the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
inj_report.long: Vidal's 15 offensive snaps were just ahead of Keaton Mitchell's 13, but both running backs took a back seat to Omarion Hampton, who was on the field for 36 of the Chargers' 57 snaps on offense and led the backfield with 22 carries for 105 yards and one touchdown. Vidal's two carries were his fewest since Week 3 against the Bills (one), although his 15-yard catch early in the third quarter set the Chargers up just outside the red zone, with Cameron Dicker connecting on a 34-yard field goal four plays later. Vidal and Mitchell appear to be falling into rotational roles behind Hampton heading into Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Burks (foot) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bengals.
inj_report.long: Burks was held out of Friday's practice while managing a foot injury, but he returned Saturday as a full participant, which was enough for him to shed an injury tag for Monday's contest. Over his last six outings, Burks has caught 14 passes on 24 targets for 260 yards and two touchdowns, and he has operated as operated as the Commanders' WR3 since Terry McLaurin suffered a season-ending knee injury in Week 6 against the 49ers.

inj_report.short: Washington caught one pass for five yards on two targets in Sunday night's loss to the Bengals.
inj_report.long: Aaron Rodgers threw for 143 yards in the game, and most of that came in garbage time in the second half with the score already out of hand. Washington has fewer than 30 receiving yards in seven of nine games played this season and is the epitome of a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at tight end.

inj_report.short: Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Worthy ran a team-high 37 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks, but on a day Mahomes targeted nine different players, Worthy was the only one to not record a catch. With Josh Downs now in the fold and working to get comfortable in the offense, Worthy's role will likely only continue to shrink. On just eight routes in his team debut Sunday, Downs posted a 4-53-1 receiving line on five targets. Worthy hasn't produced that many fantasy points in a game all season. He's waiver-wire fodder in 12-team redraft leagues.

Johnson has been working as the Bucs' WR3 behind Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin, with rookie Ted Hurst mixing in for sub-package snaps. Johnson isn't a particularly exciting fantasy bet.

inj_report.long: Treadwell played a position-high 40 of 50 offensive snaps but continues to run wind sprints in an offense that doesn't throw the ball down the field. Through 11 games this season, Treadwell has just 19 catches for 239 yards and one touchdown on 33 targets.

inj_report.short: Harris secured all five targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
inj_report.long: With Ladd McConkey (back) sidelined, Harris functioned as a de facto top target for Justin Herbert, and he was responsible for all but 43 of his quarterback's passing yards. The yardage tally also was a career-high figure for Harris, who generated team-high totals with all three components of his receiving line. Harris is up to a career-high 348 receiving yards on 26 catches heading into a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Jets on Sunday.

He was deemed questionable to return at the beginning of the third quarter and subsequently was ruled out shortly thereafter. The rookie running back gained seven yards on three carries and caught his only target for one yard before exiting while adding 117 yards on three kickoff returns. Jonathan Taylor should continue to get most of the work at running back for the Colts for the rest of the game, and DJ Giddens should handle whatever backfield snaps that Taylor doesn't get.

inj_report.short: Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
inj_report.long: The four catches matched Engram's season high, and his 33 yards were his most since Week 5. It goes without saying, but Engram is well off the fantasy radar at tight end. He has 17 catches for 169 yards and one touchdown through nine games, averaging a career-low 18.8 yards per contest.

inj_report.short: Knox will likely be the Bills' top tight end against the Dolphins on Sunday, given that Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for that contest, Maddy Glab of the Bills' official site reports.
inj_report.long: Kincaid was held out of practice all week while tending to thumb and ankle injuries, and he's trending toward being inactive for Sunday's AFC East tilt. If Kincaid is indeed ruled out, then Knox will operate as the Bills' top tight end, with Jackson Hawes (shoulder) and Keleki Latu also in line for larger roles on offense. Knox has 14 catches (on 20 targets) for 86 yards and a touchdown through nine regular-season games, and the Bills face a Dolphins defense that ranks 25th in the NFL in fantasy points allowed per game to opposing tight ends.

inj_report.short: Johnson caught his only target for four yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: For the third time in seven appearances this season, Johnson didn't log a single carry. The veteran running back also didn't have much of a role in the passing game with just one target. In fact, Johnson tallied just 10 offensive snaps, finishing behind both starter James Cook (35) and fellow backup Ray Davis (12). Johnson has had a few productive performances as a pass catcher this season, but his role is too unpredictable to warrant weekly fantasy consideration.

inj_report.long: Allen looked rejuvenated in his 49ers debut after coming over from the Colts at the deadline, finishing third in receptions and receiving yards and second in targets for his new squad in the wild win. Allen and Brock Purdy seemed to have instant chemistry despite having practiced on only three occasions coming into the contest, and the veteran receiver's production should have a good chance of spiking further down the stretch of the regular season.

inj_report.short: Bech caught two of seven targets for 10 yards during the Raiders' 21-13 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Bech was the favorite target of rookie first-overall pick Fernando Mendoza, who was making his first career start Sunday after the Raiders shipped Kirk Cousins to the Vikings at the Nov. 10 trade deadline. Bech's seven targets were a season high, but he mustered only two catches for his efforts, and he failed to connect on each of the last four passes he saw from Mendoza in the fourth quarter. The volume appears to be there for Bech, and he could take on a larger role offensively in Week 11 against the Broncos on Nov. 22 if star tight end Brock Bowers (ankle) is unable to play.

inj_report.short: Vele caught both of his targets for 14 yards during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Vele was on the field for 55 of the Saints' 63 offensive snaps, which was second most among wide receivers behind Chris Olave (56). Despite that playing time, Vele saw only two targets Sunday, although no other Saints pass catcher logged more than three receptions other than rookie first-rounder Jordyn Tyson, who finished with 11 catches on 13 targets for 80 yards. Vele has two receptions in each of his last two outings, and it appears his role in the Saints' passing offense has shrunk due to the return of Tyson. Vele will look to bounce back for Week 11 against the Bears on Nov. 22, and Chicago's defense ranks 15th in the NFL in fantasy points allowed to receivers per game.

inj_report.short: Iosivas (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Iosivas was a full participant in all three practices during Week 11 prep, but it looks like the fourth-year wide receiver will stay on injured reserve for at least one more week while recovering from a thumb injury. If he's inactive for Monday's game, then his next chance to play would be Week 12 against the Saints on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_timeline.note: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

inj_report.long: Bateman put together a solid performance during his first opportunity to work with Jacoby Brissett, posting his best receiving yardage total since Week 5. The veteran wideout also recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three games, and two of his three catches went for first downs. Bateman seemed to lay a solid foundation with his new signal-caller, and he'll look to continue building on it in a Week 11 road matchup against the Panthers.

inj_report.short: Price is set for an increase in offensive workload with Jordan Addison (thumb) sidelined, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Price reeled in a season-high four passes for 49 yards and a score during Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. Addison now is expected to undergo thumb surgery, opening the door for Price to operate in an elevated position in Minnesota's offense for the time being.

inj_report.short: Wilson (hand/finger) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
inj_report.long: The third-year wideout was activated from injured reserve Saturday, foreshadowing his availability for Sunday's contest following a four-game absence. Wilson recorded at least three receptions in his first four games of the season on his way to a 14-188-2 line on 25 targets, and he then failed to reel in the only pass thrown his way in Week 5 against the Colts before exiting that game at halftime with his injury. In his return Sunday against Philadelphia, Wilson should slot into the No. 3 receiver role behind DK Metcalf and rookie Germie Bernard, the latter who leapfrogged Wilson on the depth chart over the last several games while filling in for both him and Michael Pittman (IR, foot).

inj_report.short: Higgins played 24 of 35 offensive snaps (68.6 percent) but didn't get a target during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Week 10 was Higgins' first game since signing a three-year contract extension worth up to $26.8 million. He didn't have much to show for it during Sunday's loss, although the Cardinals finished with a measly 17:37 time of possession, and the offense struggled as a whole with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck under center. Higgins will take an 18-162-1 receiving line on 20 targets through 10 games into Arizona's Week 11 tilt against Kansas City on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Gadsden hauled in his lone target for seven yards in Monday's 23-20 win over Baltimore.
inj_report.long: Gadsden went to the locker room during the first half of Monday's game after being poked in the ye, but the second-year tight end was cleared to return for the second quarter. However, his 12 offensive snaps were his lowest since Week 1 against the Cardinals (10), and that lack of playing time coincided with the return of veteran tight end David Njoku, who missed the Chargers' six prior games while on IR due to a fibula injury. Njoku and Charlie Kolar appear to be the Chargers' top options at tight end, squeezing Gadsden out of the game plan ahead of Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Felton is on track to operate in a more prominent role in Week 11 versus the 49ers, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Felton drew a start in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers, reeling in a season-high three of five targets for 33 yards over 56 offensive snaps. The wide receiver stepped into a starting role as a result of Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf) being sidelined, and Addison is now reportedly set to undergo surgery to address his injury, opening the door for more opportunities for Felton moving forward.

inj_report.short: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
inj_report.long: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this season.

inj_report.long: Ott was unable to play against the Falcons in Week 10 due to a hamstring injury. However, the undrafted rookie out of Oklahoma was cleared to practice in full Wednesday, so he should be available for Sunday's home game against the Cardinals. If Kenneth Walker (groin) cannot play in Week 11, then Ott would have the opportunity to serve as the Chiefs' RB2 behind rookie fifth-rounder Emmett Johnson.

inj_report.long: Gould was the rather unlikely leader in receiving yards for the Colts on the night, with a team-high 31-yard catch playing a big role in getting him there. The 2024 fifth-round pick has seen an expanded role in the wake of the trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, and for as long as Alec Pierce (IR, heel) is sidelined, Gould could function as one of Indianapolis' top downfield threats for either Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson or Riley Leonard.

inj_report.short: Sample caught all three of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win against Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: Sample entered the contest with no catches over his previous two games, but he tied season-high marks in both receptions and targets versus the Steelers. He gave Cincinnati a two-score lead just after the beginning of the second quarter when he hauled in a three-yard TD from Joe Burrow. Sample has two touchdowns over his past four games, but with just five catches for 39 yards during that span, he's almost entirely dependent on getting into the end zone to generate useful fantasy production.

inj_report.short: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
inj_report.long: As his final line indicates, Ekeler retained a solid level of involvement in the narrow win, logging a season-high 13 touches. He posted a new season high in receiving yards along the way, and the veteran back has proven to be a solid complement to Rachaad White while Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin, IR) has been sidelined. However, with the latter potentially set to return as soon as Week 11's home matchup against the Bengals, Ekeler could be headed to a reduced role.

inj_report.long: Njoku briefly exited in the first quarter after hurting his shoulder on a 13-yard catch. He was initially deemed questionable to return but has since re-entered the contest. The veteran tight end is playing just his second game after returning from a stint on IR due to a fibula injury.

inj_report.short: Singletary played just five snaps on offense and took one carry for three yards in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Cam Skattebo came back from a hamstring injury and dominated backfield work, taking 21 touches for 122 yards and two touchdowns on an 88 percent snap share. Singletary played 92 percent of snaps the week before in a win at Philadelphia, but his 23 touches went for just 39 total yards and no TDs. It'll likely be another large workload for Skattebo when the Giants host the Jaguars in Week 11.

inj_report.short: Corbin was elevated from the Cowboys' practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
inj_report.long: Corbin signed with the Cowboys' practice squad Nov. 4, and Saturday was his first elevation to the 53-man roster. With Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) both on injured reserve, Corbin will operate as Dallas' RB2 behind workhorse Javonte Williams. Corbin last saw regular-season action in 2023, when he appeared in six games as a member of the Giants.

inj_report.short: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.
inj_report.long: A 2025 undrafted free agent who played alongside Cam Ward during their final collegiate seasons at Miami, Restrepo showed immediate chemistry with the Titans' second-year quarterback during a 40-23 loss to the Jaguars in Week 10. Restrepo went on to play 19 snaps following Robinson's exit late in the third quarter and notched three receptions for 31 yards on three targets over the game's final 10 minutes. While the Titans are expected to get rookie first-round pick Carnell Tate (shoulder) back for Sunday's game in Dallas, Restrepo's strong showing in relief of the injured Robinson last week should at least allow him to stick ahead of Calvin Ridley (four snaps in Week 10) as Tennessee's No. 4 wideout.

inj_report.short: Gray (ribs) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against Arizona.
inj_report.long: Gray's injury status was announced late in the game after Kansas City had already built an insurmountable lead, so it would be a surprise if the tight end returns to the contest. The bigger picture is the Chiefs' Thanksgiving matchup against Buffalo -- if Gray is dealing with a more-than-minor issue, his availability for that game could be in peril. Gray finished Sunday's matchup with three catches for 21 yards on five targets.

inj_report.short: Mims caught one of two targets for zero yards, added a five-yard carry and returned three punts for 22 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Nineteen of Mims' 24 snaps came on offense, although he logged only two touches in the process. He hasn't seen more than four targets in a game this season, with most of his output coming on special teams as a returner on both kickoffs and punts. The Broncos are on a bye for Week 10, so their next game will take place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22

inj_report.short: Kolar (concussion) is active for Sunday's game versus the Jets.
inj_report.long: Kolar showed up on the Chargers' first Week 11 injury report Wednesday as a non-participant due to a concussion, and thereafter he managed just one limited session Friday before the team tagged him as questionable for Sunday. Despite his inability to practice fully this week and the prospect of gaining clearance from an independent neurologist shaped up as a difficult combination to overcome, he's available to the offense. Kolar will join Oronde Gadsden and David Njoku as L.A.'s active tight ends this weekend.

inj_report.long: Burks was the No. 2 wide receiver for the Colts in the contest. Despite being targeted three times, the wide receiver could not haul in any passes from since-cut quarterback Daniel Jones. Burks played 32 offensive snaps and two special-teams snaps in the contest.

inj_report.short: Fant failed to haul in his lone target during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Fant didn't connect with Tyler Shough on a short pass late in the first quarter, and that ended up being the only target for the veteran tight end. Fant has a 12-96-3 line on 19 targets through eight regular-season games, although he's logged one reception or zero in four of his last five outings. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal as the Saints' TE2 behind Juwan Johnson heading into Week 11 against the Bears on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Nailor recorded one reception for minus-1 yard on four targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: Making his first NFL start, No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza was under siege throughout the afternoon, as a ferocious Seahawks defense sacked him six times and limited him to just 143 passing yards on 29 attempts. As a result, Nailor and the Raiders' other pass catchers were held quiet, with running back Ashton Jeanty (four receptions for 46 yards) being the only Las Vegas player to top two catches and 25 receiving yards. Though Mendoza will get some more favorable matchups over the Raiders' final seven games, Nailor will be difficult to count on for production. Even while Kirk Cousins served as the starting quarterback for Las Vegas before being traded to the Vikings last week, Nailor was limited to just 14 receptions for 122 yards and one touchdown on 28 targets through eight appearances.

inj_report.short: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.
inj_report.long: It was a quiet day for TeSlaa, with the Lions' offense being powered by usual suspects Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs, with the latter duo combining for four touchdowns (three receiving, one rushing). TeSlaa was the other Lions player to find the end zone, which took place early in the second quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from Jared Goff. It was the first touchdown catch of the season for TeSlaa, who found the end zone six times across 17 regular-season games during his rookie campaign in 2025. He has been the Lions' distant WR3 behind St. Brown and Jameson Williams, and that shouldn't change ahead of the team's Week 11 tilt against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Bell (chest) has returned to Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
inj_report.long: Bell suffered a chest injury late in the first half and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, the rookie wideout got back into the game shortly after halftime. Bell will look to be more productive after finishing the first half without a reception.

inj_report.short: Etienne took three carries for one yard and caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 20-17 win at New Orleans. He also returned three punts for 43 yards.
inj_report.long: Etienne again played second fiddle to starter Chuba Hubbard in Week 10 with Jonathon Brooks sidelined by a groin injury, and Etienne got his second-most touches of the season. His role on offense in Week 11 will depend on Brooks' status, but the vast majority of the Panthers' snaps at tailback will continue to go to Hubbard.
