inj_report.short: Duvernay caught two of three targets for 35 yards during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Duvernay was on the field for only 10 of the Cardinals' 35 offensive snaps (28.6 percent), but the veteran wide receiver connected with rookie third-round quarterback Carson Beck on passes of four and 31 yards on back-to-back plays late in the first quarter. Duvernay finished the contest second in catches, targets and receiving yards behind Trey McBride, and he's caught two passes in each of his last three outings. With Michael Wilson (neck) out for the year, the Cardinals' top wideouts for the rest of the season appear to be Duvernay, Simi Fehoko and rookie fifth-rounder Reggie Virgil, which doesn't inspire much confidence heading into Week 11 against Kansas City on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three targets and caught one of Trevor Lawrence's three TDs. Thomas will take a 13-146-2 line on 26 targets over nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

inj_report.short: Schoonmaker (illness) is active for Sunday's Week 11 matchup against Tennessee.
inj_report.long: Schoonmaker was unable to practice Thursday or Friday because he was under the weather, but the tight end appears to be feeling well enough to suit up Sunday. Meanwhile, Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) will miss his second straight game, opening the door for Schoonmaker to potentially log a larger workload than usual on offense. With Ferguson out last Sunday versus San Francisco, Schoonmaker posted a season-high 35 percent offensive snap share and caught one of two targets for 12 yards.

inj_report.short: Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23, Week 10 win over Tennessee. He also returned five kickoffs for 142 yards.
inj_report.long: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. Cameron's propensity for finding the end zone (his three TDs have come on just 12 total catches) is appealing, but at this point he isn't getting enough volume to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy asset.

inj_report.short: Cooper caught just two of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) still out, Cooper played more than 90 percent of the offensive snaps for the third straight game. He's done very little with that playing time, producing five catches for 61 yards during that span. Cooper is well off the fantasy radar until he shows something in the box score, and that's if Smith and Wicks remain sidelined.

inj_report.short: Shipley (foot) is active for Sunday's game against Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: Shipley was activated from injured reserve Saturday, and the third-year running back has been officially cleared to return from a four-game absence due to a partial plantar fascia tear that he sustained in Week 5 against the Jaguars. Shipley and Jaydon Blue will operate as the Eagles' rotational running backs behind Saquon Barkley for Sunday's game against a Steelers defense that ranks third in the NFL in rushing yards allowed per game (83.2).

inj_report.long: Johnson hasn't been able to get going in 2026, as he's finished with one or zero catches in six of his seven games so far. After working as New York's top tight end last season, he's been mostly an afterthought in the current campaign due to the arrival of Isaiah Likely, who went off for a 9-127-1 line on a team-leading 11 targets Thursday. As long as Likely is healthy, Johnson won't have much appeal in most fantasy formats.

inj_report.long: The elevation of Carter gives the Titans extra depth at running back following the placement of Tyjae Spears (knee) on injured reserve. Carter -- who has appeared in three regular-season games for Tennessee -- is listed as the fourth running back on the depth chart behind Tony Pollard, Julius Chestnut and rookie fifth-rounder Nicholas Singleton.

inj_report.short: Mooney caught two of five targets for eight yards Thursday in a loss to Washington.
inj_report.long: Mooney logged the third-most targets of any New York pass catcher, but he managed just two short receptions. Efficiency has been an issue for the veteran wideout throughout the campaign, as he's hauled in only 14 of 30 targets through nine contests. Mooney has finished with fewer than 10 yards in four of his past six appearances, so he's not a viable fantasy play at the moment.

inj_report.short: Allen caught two of four targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: The rookie wideout scored his first career touchdown by beating the cornerback on a stutter-go for a 39-yard touchdown in the third quarter. With Josh Downs still getting comfortable and learning the offense following Tuesday's acquisition from the Colts, Allen maintained a significant role on offense, playing 22 of 64 offensive snaps. Once Downs progresses from the 10 snaps he played against Atlanta, it will be interesting to see if Allen can push Xavier Worthy (zero catches on three targets across 56 snaps on Sunday) for a larger piece of the outside receiver role in Kansas City's offense.

inj_report.short: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Meyers reeled in multiple passes for the third straight game, and he was able to secure his first score of the year in the second quarter on a 15-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow. The 26-year-old's 28 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Cincinnati behind Ja'Marr Chase (59), Tee Higgins (51) and Colbie Young (29). With Andrei Iosivas (thumb) nearing a return to action, Meyers may see a sharp drop in offensive opportunities in the near future.

inj_report.short: Roush caught both of his two targets for 23 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
inj_report.long: Roush, who has been utilized heavily as a blocker through nine games, achieved a new career high in receiving yards in Week 9. Roush has been relatively efficient with his limited targets so far this season, but Colston Loveland should be expected to continue to handle a substantial majority of the Bears' pass-catching duties at tight end as long as he's available.

inj_report.short: Turpin is expected to resume return duties on both kickoffs and punts Sunday against the Titans, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.
inj_report.long: The wide receiver had to sit for three games with a rib injury before coming back for last Sunday's loss to the 49ers, in which he fielded punts but not kickoffs. Turpin has 574 kickoff-return yards and 108 punt-return yards on the year.

inj_report.long: Franklin drew a 27-yard pass interference penalty on the Broncos' second offensive play of the game, but the third-year wide receiver didn't log his first catch until early in the fourth quarter. He has operated in a rotational role for most of the season, and even with Jaylen Waddle in the league's concussion protocol, Franklin will likely maintain that workload following the Broncos' Week 10 bye.

inj_report.short: Donaldson (shoulder) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

Even if Donaldson does suit up, his role in the backfield figures to be minimal, seeing as Travis Etienne is off injured reserve and Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime are also available for the Saints.

Cuevas has now caught 13 of 16 targets for 171 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

Stroud late in the third quarter. Moreau is up to a 12-80-3 receiving line on 15 targets through 10 regular-season games and has caught one pass or zero in five of those contests. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal unless Schultz were to miss time.

inj_report.short: Bartholomew should revert to a backup role with T.J. Hockenson returning from a wrist injury for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
inj_report.long: Bartholomew was targeted four times in Week 10 for three catches, 36 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers. The tight end received more than one target in only one other game this season, Week 5, when Hockenson went down after two offensive snaps. While Bartholomew has proven himself a red-zone threat, Hockenson should return to seeing most of the tight end volume in Sunday's contest.

inj_report.short: The Eagles signed Ertz from the practice squad to the active roster Monday.
inj_report.long: Philadelphia is coming off a Week 10 bye, but prior to the midseason respite, there were no reported injuries in the TE group on the active roster. When the position group was depleted earlier this season, the team used elevations on Ertz from Weeks 3-5, but his snap share decreased game by game (38, 21 and 11 percent), while he hauled in three of eight targets for 22 yards in that span. Wednesday's practice report will reveal if any of Dallas Goedert, Eli Stowers, Johnny Mundt or Grant Calcaterra are banged up at the moment.

inj_report.short: Coleman logged one catch for six yards on six targets in Sunday's Week 10 loss to Indianapolis.
inj_report.long: Coleman couldn't get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who made his first NFL regular-season appearance. In fact, Coleman has been quiet inefficient regardless of who has thrown him the ball this year, as he has just nine receptions on 27 targets through nine games. Two of his nine catches have been touchdowns, but he's not getting enough touches to be a trustworthy fantasy option.

inj_report.short: Hurst failed to haul in his lone target during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
inj_report.long: For a third consecutive game, the rookie third-rounder didn't record a catch while seeing only one target. Of more concern was the fact that Hurst was on the field for only one offensive snap in Week 9 after logging at least 25 offensive snaps in each of the first eight games of the regular season. That lack of offensive playing time coincided with the return of Emeka Egbuka, although Hurst also saw less snaps than Chris Godwin (62), Tez Johnson (52) and even David Sills (six), although Sills was cut by the Buccaneers on Tuesday. With the Buccaneers on a bye for Week 10, Hurst will look for better results in Week 11 against the Lions on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_timeline.note: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Tucker didn't log any offensive snaps in a loss to the Bears on Sunday. He returned four kickoffs for 92 yards.
inj_report.long: It was the second straight week in which Tucker went without an offensive snap. That's happened despite Tampa Bay going to the ground plenty during that span. Perhaps not coincidentally, Tucker has begun working as a kick returner during the two-game stretch. It appears he's not going to get many opportunities on offense as long as Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell are healthy.

inj_report.short: Wright caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Wright tied season highs in both receiving yards and catches during Sunday's win, and his 39 snaps on offense were second-most among Lions tight ends behind Sam LaPorta (56). Wright has accumulated seven catches on eight target for 42 yards across nine regular-season games, and he's mostly served as a blocking tight end on the Lions' offense.

inj_report.short: The Cardinals elevated Jones from the practice squad Saturday.
inj_report.long: The veteran wideout played seven offensive snaps in Arizona's loss to the Rams last Sunday. With a boatload of injuries at the position, Jones figures to have a role for the foreseeable future. He has no fantasy appeal in this injury-ruined offense.

inj_report.short: Allen (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
inj_report.long: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.

inj_report.short: Wallace recorded a nine-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: Though he played just five of the Cardinals' 35 snaps on offense, Wallace was able to come away with his first NFL reception in the third quarter. Even if Wallace earns more playing time in future weeks, he'll likely struggle to produce meaningful fantasy lines while rookie third-round pick Carson Beck continues to direct the offense behind a shaky offensive line.

inj_report.short: Davis (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: The backup running back was managed during the practice week but is good to go for his normal role behind lead back James Cook. With the Bills listed as 16.5-point favorites, Davis could see some extra reps in garbage time if Buffalo does indeed blow out Miami.

inj_report.short: Dallas caught his only target for a two-yard gain in Monday's Week 9 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: Dallas notched just eight offensive snaps but also contributed 19 snaps on special teams. The veteran running back went without a carry for the fourth time over Minnesota's past five games, indicating his lack of a role in the running game. Overall this season, Dallas has been a very small part of the Vikings' offense, recording four carries for 14 yards and five catches for 36 yards (on five targets) through eight contests.

inj_report.short: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.
inj_report.long: Sinnott gave the Commanders a lead just before halftime when he reeled in a one-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels. It was his first TD of the season and the third of his career. Sinnott's four grabs came out of nowhere, as he'd logged just one catch on two targets through his first eight games of the season. He also ranked third among Washington tight ends Thursday with 24 offensive snaps -- behind Chig Okonkwo (41) and John Bates (28) -- so fantasy managers probably don't need to go rushing to the waiver wire to pick him up. With that said, Sinnott may have earned himself more opportunities with Thursday's effort.

inj_report.short: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected back in the bear future. Watkins doesn't have much fantasy appeal as an ancillary option.

inj_report.short: Metchie caught his only target for four yards Sunday in a 20-17 win against New Orleans.
inj_report.long: Metchie's only catch and target came late in the third quarter, as he logged four yards on a third-down play to help set up a Ryan Fitzgerald field goal. The veteran wideout had a streak of six games with multiple catches snapped in the Carolina victory. Metchie finished third among Panthers wideouts with 23 offensive snaps, and he's produced like a No. 3 receiver this year, logging no more than three catches and 40 yards in any of his eight games to date.

inj_report.short: Chestnut played all 25 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: The fifth-year running back has suited up for all nine of the Titans' games this season, but he's been deployed almost exclusively on special teams as a member of the team's kick coverage and return units. He's played just two offensive snaps on the campaign and hasn't logged any carries or targets.

inj_report.long: Klein surprisingly outpaced veteran position mates Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau on the night, and the rookie second-round pick, whose only other career reception coming in was a 16-yard grab in Week 1, added his first career touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the third quarter. Given Klein had been a complete non-factor coming into the night, it's difficult to predict whether Thursday's production will have any carryover to a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Hawes (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Hawes was in danger of missing this contest due to a shoulder issue, though he will avoid his first absence of the 2026 campaign Sunday versus Miami. With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) sidelined in Week 11, Hawes will have an opportunity to get more involved than usual behind Dawson Knox.

inj_report.short: Briningstool caught one of two targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 35-13 win against the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Briningstool connected with Patrick Mahomes for a 20-yard reception midway through the first quarter but didn't record another reception. The 23-year-old tight end has exactly one catch in each of his past three games. That's not enough production to warrant fantasy consideration, but Briningstool is at least showing growth as a pass catcher, as he had just one catch on two targets over his first six contests of the campaign.

inj_report.short: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.
inj_report.long: Yankoff sat out the Commanders' contest against the Giants in Week 10 because of a knee injury, but it now looks like he's put it behind him. He figures to resume a depth role at tight end in Week 11 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: The Raiders elevated Runyon from the practice squad Saturday.
inj_report.long: Las Vegas is bringing up Runyon due to Brock Bowers (ankle) being listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos. Runyon appeared in 13 games with the Raiders last season but logged just 45 offensive snaps and caught only one pass for three yards. He's depth behind Michael Mayer and Ian Thomas.

inj_report.short: The Jets elevated Shepard from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: The move gives the Jets much-needed depth at wide receiver given the absences of both Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) for Sunday's game against the Chargers. It will be the third elevation of the season for Shepard and first since Week 4 against the Bears, so he would need to be signed to the 53-man roster in order to suit up for the Jets beyond Week 11.

inj_report.short: Brooks carried three times for 12 yards while taking the field for three of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: All three of Brooks' carries came during the Bengals' final possession of the fourth quarter, when the team had already built a sizable lead and opted to rest multiple key players, including top running back Chase Brown. Brooks has been active for all nine of the Bengals' games to date but has logged just six carries, all of which have come late in blowout victories. So long as Brown and Samaje Perine are both available, Brooks will continue to see limited playing time on offense.

inj_report.short: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Johnson injured his ankle while on kickoff coverage early in the first quarter. He was carted off the field, and medical staff have determined that the injury is severe enough for Johnson to be sidelined for the rest of Sunday's contest. Salvon Ahmed will move into the RB3 role behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai in Johnson's absence.

inj_report.short: Johnson played all 17 of his snaps on special teams and recorded one tackle in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Johnson, a reserve wide receiver, has been used almost exclusively on special teams through his two-plus seasons in Tampa Bay. He's logged just 15 total snaps on offense through nine games in 2026, recording a three-yard reception on two targets. Johnson leads the Buccaneers with 14 kickoff returns for 389 yards, but he didn't see any runback opportunities in Week 9 while Sean Tucker handled those duties.

inj_report.short: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.
inj_report.long: Though he's been active for five straight games while the Commanders' receiving depth has taken hits due to season-ending injuries to Terry McLaurin (knee) and Jaylin Lane (ankle), McCaffrey has yet to carve out much of a role on offense. He took the field for a season-high 14 of the Commanders' 69 offensive plays in Week 10 but went without a target. McCaffrey is likely to continue to provide his greatest impact on special teams, where he appears to have settled in as the Commanders' top return man on both kickoffs and punts.

inj_report.long: Young suffered a stinger late in the first half, and his availability for the rest of the game is now in question. In his absence, Cody White is a candidate to see a slight uptick in opportunities on offense with Las Vegas.

inj_report.short: Davis didn't touch the ball on offense in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: With Breece Hall and Braelon Allen both healthy, Davis has minimal fantasy value, except for leagues that count return yardage. He's played zero offensive snaps over the last two contests, but Davis did return three kickoffs for 74 yards against Buffalo.

inj_report.short: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.
inj_report.long: James' practice reps were limited both Thursday and Friday due to a calf injury. He was limited to kickoff return duties against the Cowboys in Week 10, and that role could be taken over by Deebo Samuel and/or Jacob Cowing if James is unable to play Sunday.

inj_report.short: The Chiefs elevated Carter from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.
inj_report.long: Carter has been brought up from the practice squad for a second consecutive week to give the Chiefs more depth in the backfield in the absence of Kenneth Walker (groin). Carter operated as the Chiefs' RB2 behind rookie fifth-rounder Emmett Johnson in Week 10 against the Falcons, but the former's role could be limited to special-teams duties since Jaydn Ott (hamstring) has been cleared to return from a one-game absence.

inj_report.short: Armstrong caught his only target for a 43-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: The wideout played just 17 of 64 offensive snaps against Atlanta and ran only seven pass routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks. Armstrong was tasked with blocking duties on 10 of his snaps. He still managed to catch his first career touchdown in the fourth quarter with the game already well out of hand. Armstrong is not on the fantasy radar.

inj_report.short: Laube played all 22 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks and returned two kickoffs for 46 yards and one punt for zero yards.
inj_report.long: Since earning seven touches in a Week 5 blowout loss to the Patriots, Laube has been an afterthought on offense. He's played just eight total offense snaps in the Raiders' ensuing five games, and Sunday marked the first time all season that he was limited exclusively to special teams.

inj_report.short: Moore caught one of two targets for minus-3 yards during the Eagles' 19-11 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Week 9 was the Eagles' first game with Joe Milton as the starter, with Tanner McKee relegated to backup duties. Milton completed 18 of his 34 passes, and his lone connection with Moore resulted in a three-yard loss. The Eagles are on a bye for Week 10, and Moore's role on the offense would evaporate if one or both of DeVonta Smith (hamstring) or Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was cleared to play in Week 11 against the Steelers on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Saylors rushed twice for nine yards while adding 26 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.
inj_report.long: Saylors played six snaps on offense while serving as a No. 3 option behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Sione Vaki in the backfield. Saylors was on the field for 20 snaps with the special-teams unit, and he'll continue to be primarily a special-teams asset in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

inj_report.short: Ali played all 19 of his snaps on special teams in Monday's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
inj_report.long: For the second week in a row, Ali was deployed exclusively on special teams while the Ravens leaned on Derrick Henry and Justice Hill to handle all the snaps out of the backfield. Ali has logged just seven total snaps on offense all season, carrying six times for 24 yards.

inj_report.short: The Broncos elevated Schrader from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Susanna Weir of the team's official site reports.
inj_report.long: Schrader's elevation is his third of the season, so he'll need to be signed to Denver's active roster in order to see game action for the team beyond Sunday. In his previous two appearances, the third-year pro played a total of two offensive snaps and nine snaps on special teams without recording any carries or targets. Schrader isn't likely to be much of a factor on offense Sunday against Las Vegas, as Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should continue to lead the Broncos' backfield. However, Schrader could contribute as a kick returner -- he's tallied 68 yards on three kickoff returns this season.

inj_report.short: VanSumeren (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
inj_report.long: VanSumeran injured his knee in the second half, and with no other fullback on the 53-man roster, the Chiefs could turn to tight end Jake Briningstool to provide additional blocking out of the backfield. VanSumeran's status over the coming days will be worth monitoring, given that the Chiefs are operating on a short week and play against the Bills on Thanksgiving Day.

inj_timeline.note: VanSumeren (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

inj_report.short: The Eagles signed Blue from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
inj_report.long: It's already the third time this season Blue has been signed by Philadelphia from the practice squad to the active roster. The second-year pro has seen action in two games with the club, recording a nine-yard catch on his only touch while racking up 268 yards on 12 kickoff returns. Blue is currently the only healthy running back on the Eagles' active roster aside from starter Saquon Barkley, but that may change soon, as Will Shipley (foot - IR) had his practice window opened Monday. Elijah Mitchell has been promoted from the practice squad to help in the backfield each of the past three weeks, so he'd need to be signed to the active roster as well in order to suit up against Pittsburgh this Sunday.

He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a contributor on special teams.

inj_report.short: The Giants elevated Mafah from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
inj_report.long: It's the second time this season that Mafah has been promoted to the 53-man roster, with the first instance being Week 10 against the Eagles. His elevation gives the Giants another contributor on special teams and extra depth in the backfield behind Cam Skattebo, Devin Singletary and Greg Desrosiers.

inj_report.short: Lance returned three kickoffs for 55 yards during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The rookie fourth-rounder didn't see a target from Tyler Shough during Sunday's loss, and Lance has not recorded a catch in each of his last two outings, coinciding with the return of 2026 first-round wide receiver Jordyn Tyson. Lance's nine offensive snaps were a season low, and he figures to be limited to return duties now that Tyson is back in the fold. The Saints will hit the road for Week 11 against the Bears on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Giddens rushed one time for five yards and caught his lone target for 11 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
inj_report.long: With Seth McGowan (hamstring) exiting early with an injury, Giddens spelled Jonathan Taylor and played seven offensive snaps. Through three games this season, Giddens has rushed seven times for 48 yards and registered one catch for 11 yards. If McGowan's injury costs him time, Giddens figures to handle RB2 duties in his absence.

inj_report.short: Covey (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Covey was a limited participant in all three practices during Week 11 prep, but the veteran wide receiver has done enough to be cleared to return from a two-game absence due to a knee injury. He'll likely operate as the Eagles' top return option on kickoffs and punts while providing depth at wide receiver.

inj_report.short: Conklin went without a target while playing 22 of the Lions' 71 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.

inj_report.short: Flacco took the field for the Bengals' final possession of Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers, attempting no passes while handing off to running back Tahj Brooks on all three of his snaps.
inj_report.long: With the Bengals having built their lead to 20 by the midway point of the fourth quarter, head coach Zac Taylor pulled starter Joe Burrow from the contest and turned to Flacco to run down the clock in the win. The appearance was Flacco's third of the season, but the veteran signal-caller still has yet to attempt a pass.

While Jackson remains sidelined for at least a few more weeks, the Ravens will entrust trade-deadline acquisition Jacoby Brissett to direct the offense.

inj_report.short: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.
inj_report.long: After Aiyuk filed his paperwork for reinstatement, San Francisco activated him from the reserve/left squad list Nov. 9. Rosenhaus noted that Aiyuk passed his physical at that time, with MRIs and X-rays on his surgically repaired knee revealing no concerns. The 49ers were granted a two-week roster exemption for Aiyuk that will expire next Monday, and the 28-year-old wideout is expected to be cut loose at that time since San Francisco seemingly hasn't expressed interested in retaining him. While it's unclear what kind of market might exist for Aiyuk's services coming off a lengthy layoff from NFL action, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz relayed earlier this month that at least one NFC team has expressed interest in adding the receiver to its practice squad.

inj_report.short: Zvada missed his only field-goal try and made all three of his PATs on Thursday in a loss to Washington.
inj_report.long: Zvada's miss was a chip-shot 33-yarder in the first quarter that sailed wide left. That proved to be a critical mistake, as the Commanders won by just three points. Zvada appeared to shore up his job security a bit by going 4-for-4 on FG tries in Week 9 against Philadelphia, but it's hard to ignore the fact that he's gone just 17-for-23 on field-goal attempts overall and has missed three kicks from under 50 yards. The rookie does have a perfect 16-for-16 mark on extra-point attempts, and head coach John Harbaugh expressed support for the inconsistent kicker Friday, saying of Zvada, "I'm confident that he's going to become a good kicker. If at some point and time it doesn't happen, it doesn't happen. But I'm not going to panic halfway through the season with a guy who has made a bunch of kicks," Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

inj_report.short: Dicker made all three of his field-goal tries and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-20 win at Baltimore.
inj_report.long: Dicker's longest field goal on the day was only from 38 yards out, but his accuracy played a big part in the Chargers picking up their first win of the season. He hasn't missed a kick since Week 3, but the team's general inability to move the ball consistently keeps him from projecting as a top-tier fantasy option in most formats going into a Week 11 matchup versus the Jets.

The kicker proceeded to miss a 43-yarder in the second quarter of the contest, though the miss did not end up mattering to the final result of the game. McPherson is now 13-for-14 on field-goal attempts and 33-for-33 on PATs over nine contests this season.

Stevens continued what has been a mostly fine rookie campaign -- he's made 17 of 20 field-goal attempts, with all three of his misses coming from 50-plus yards. However, he's just 15-for-18 on point-after tries.

inj_report.short: Santos made both of his two field-goal attempts and converted all three of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
inj_report.long: It was an up-and-down night for Chicago's offense Sunday, as it moved the ball relatively well but committed five turnovers. Nevertheless, Santos got an opportunity to win the game on the last play of regulation with a 38-yard field goal, and it looked good from the moment it left his foot. Following a bye in Week 10, the Bears will play host to the Saints in Week 11, at which point fantasy managers might want to confirm the weather forecast in Chicago before locking Santos back into their lineups.

inj_report.short: Bass made his sole field-goal attempt and all four PATs in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Bass made a 37-yard field goal in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker continues his perfect streak, having made all 20 of his field-goal attempts so far in 2026, with three such conversions coming from beyond 50 yards.

inj_report.short: Fairbairn made his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: Fairbairn's only field goal of the night was a 27-yarder with 15 seconds remaining in the first half. The kicker is 20-for-21 on field-goal attempts and 27-for-27 on PATs over 10 regular-season games so far in 2026.

inj_report.short: Bates made all five of his PATs in the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Bates did not attempt a field goal in the contest. He remains 16-for-17 on field-goal attempts and moves to 29-for-29 on PATs through nine regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: The Dolphins elevated Carlson from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
inj_report.long: Carlson signed with the Dolphins' practice squad Tuesday, two weeks after being released by the Saints. Following the Dolphins' release of Zane Gonzalez, Carlson will operate as Miami's kicker for Sunday's game against Buffalo. In seven appearances with the Saints this season, Carlson went 8-for-12 on field-goal attempts (including 3-for-7 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 16-for-18 on extra-point tries.

inj_report.short: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Patterson went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his PATs during Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Patterson was signed by the Ravens on Wednesday, and he was able to make a 26-yard field goal as time expired in the first half before later adding a 36-yard make in the third quarter. With Tyler Loop (groin) set to miss at least two more contests while on injured reserve, Patterson will likely remain the team's starting kicker for the time being.
